name: General Multidimensional Transfer Function Peak Finding
aliases: Dynamic Peak Finding in Transfer Space
definition: A method for finding peaks in general M-dimensional transfer functions (M > 1) by dynamically finding local maxima along the ray with sufficient sampling, rather than solving for specific peak values.
summary: General Multidimensional Transfer Function Peak Finding is a direct volume rendering technique that samples at local maxima along the ray image in transfer space, using ray marching to reduce search to one dimension for accurate, low-cost rendering of noisy data.
